text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: P1 - tenant=citrine (VPC / dedicated pool) - elevated tail latency and partial timeouts observed. Alerts: p95 latency > 2s, increased 502 rate. Paging primary oncall @asha singh.

asha singh: I'm oncall, jumping in. Seeing large backlog in the tenant queue for citrine; bespoke batching config looks aggressive (very high max_batch_tokens).

ben cole: Confirmed - dashboard: tenant_queue_length spiked to ~620, avg_batch_size jumped from ~45 to 118, scheduler queue time spiked. KV cache hit ratio dropped from 92% -> 54% which aligns with big, cold batches. Link to graph: https://grafana.redwood/citrine/queues

devon li: Hypothesis: their bespoke batch profile lets huge token budgets coalesce which starves the scheduler and causes long tail. Quick mitigation: reduce tenant max_batch_tokens and tighten coalesce window. Also enable small-batch bypass for latency-sensitive requests.

asha singh: Ok doing manual override via control-plane admin API now. Will post exact payload.

asha singh: Payload I'm applying (using control-plane auth token):
```
POST https://control-plane.api.redwood.internal/admin/tenants/citrine/overrides
Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
  "scheduler": {
    "coalesce_window_ms": 30,
    "adaptive_coalesce": true,
    "burst_capacity": 2
  },
  "bypass_small_batch_threshold": 8
}
```

liam park: FYI runbook step 3: for VPC/dedicated tenants we must apply via control-plane API (not k8s), then patch the tenant config in vault for persistence. Example vault patch: `vault write secret/tenants/citrine overrides=@override.json`

asha singh: Applied override, control-plane returned 200 OK and new config is active. Immediate effect visible: tenant_queue_length dropping from ~620 -> ~78 over 90s. p95 latency reduced from ~2.4s -> ~460ms (preliminary).

ben cole: Nice. I'm seeing 502s drop as well. Need to watch for increased request throttles; some very large batched jobs might be aborted or retried - check logs for truncated responses.

zoe (cs): Thanks team. Customer impact: Citrine reported slowed throughput for batch analytics earlier today; we should decide whether to proactively notify. If fixes hold for 15m we can send a note saying we mitigated and are investigating root cause.

devon li: Also enabled a temporary fallback routing policy: requests with token_estimate > 4096 are routed to small-quantized model variant (citrine-model-q8) to reduce per-token execution time. Patch we applied:
```
PATCH /control-plane/tenants/citrine/routing
{
  "rules": [
    {"condition": "token_estimate > 4096", "route": "citrine-model-q8", "note": "temporary fallback to reduce latency"}
  ]
}
```

asha singh: Monitoring notes: KV cache warm-up is ongoing, adaptive_coalesce kicked in. Current metrics: p95=420ms, p99=1.1s, queue_length=62, error_rate(502)=0.4% (down from 5%).

ben cole: Creating incident ticket INC-9876 with timeline and actions (assigning to eng-runtime for permanent knob and model-profile adjustments). Will link to this thread and add relevant dash snapshots.

zoe (cs): I'll draft a customer-facing blurb: short summary, what we did, and next steps (root cause RCA ETA). Please flag any user-visible changes (e.g., requests routed to quantized model) — customers might notice slightly different output characteristics.

asha singh: Noted. I added a note to the ticket: "temporary overrides + fallback model may affect output distribution for very long prompts."

oncall-bot: Reminder: keep monitoring until p95 < 500ms for 30 continuous minutes to call incident recovered. Escalate if error_rate > 1% or queue_length > 200 again.

liam park: For the permanent fix, propose adding a per-tenant adaptive max_batch_tokens that scales with observed seq-length distribution and adds a hard cap. Also add a safeguard to prevent single-tenant coalescence from monopolizing scheduler slots. I'll put a proposal in the eng-runtime backlog.

asha singh: Handing off to next oncall @devon li in 10m. Leaving the overrides in place until eng-runtime changes land or we revert after RTR confirmation.

devon li: Taking over. Will keep monitoring for 60m, coordinate with runtime team for a permanent change. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Thread note: incident state=mitigated (observed p95<500ms). Will auto-close after incident monitors have been stable for configured window.
